entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A top Silverquill inkmaster and the son of Dean Embrose Lu, who learns to use light magic and loses his voice.

entities.name: Razineth
entities.description: A sallow-faced kor inkmaster who proctors the Intention & Subtext II dueling course.

entities.name: Embrose Lu
entities.description: Killian's stern father and a Silverquill dean who urges ruthless battle poetry and no reliance on others.

entities.name: Shaile
entities.description: An owlin dean who tends Killian after the duel and advises him to embrace the light.

entities.name: Fannessa Fjyorne
entities.description: A new Silverquill student who is an Oriq agent, who spikes Killian's drink and tries to recruit him.

entities.name: Doco
entities.description: Killian's bobble-headed inkling companion who hides in a book and signs encouragements.

entities.name: Quintorius
entities.description: A loxodon Lorehold student who gives Killian a book about a mute quillancer.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A dryad Witherbloom student and Killian's friend, who brews strong teas.

entities.name: Vickus
entities.description: A fourth-year Witherbloom student and Dina's date who duels Killian out of jealousy.

entities.name: Dobarius Egolt
entities.description: A quillancer who lost his voice and cast spells in sign language.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A secret society of masked mages who recruit Silverquill students.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Armored arthropod-like creatures with glowing spines that attack students at Bow's End.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The College of Eloquence of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The college of nature magic whose students include Dina and Vickus.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school of mages.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The library housing the Hall of Semantics and the Loquacious Lyceum.

entities.name: Bow's End
entities.description: A circular tavern that turns into an arena for duels.

entities.name: Rose Stage
entities.description: The stage where Razineth's duel takes place.

entities.name: Loquacious Lyceum
entities.description: A training ground hidden in the Biblioplex with an ever-growing forest.

entities.name: Hall of Semantics
entities.description: A moonlit, fog-steeped hall where Embrose lectures Killian.

events.summary: Killian readies a volume curse against Professor Razineth in a class duel on the Rose Stage.
events.quote: readied a curse meant to tear Professor Razineth apart

events.summary: Razineth attacks viciously, defeating six students before Killian.
events.quote: Razineth was unrelenting and vicious with his attacks

events.summary: Killian conjures three massive spheres of ink.
events.quote: he swept his arms through the air, summoning thick, inky ropes

events.summary: Killian traps Razineth in ink shackles that the professor severs, then hurls an ink sphere.
events.quote: a line of ink, thinner than the width of a spider's web, had been snaking upward from the ground like a tall vine behind him

events.summary: Killian's ink bursts into trolls that Razineth absorbs into a shield.
events.quote: where its pieces landed immediately sprang ink-made trolls wielding hammers and axes

events.summary: Killian's final orb becomes a cyclone that engulfs Razineth.
events.quote: it touched down, catching the professor in its torrent

events.summary: Razineth hits Killian with a black ink arrow while he is distracted.
events.quote: a soft t had leapt from Razineth's tongue

events.summary: Killian meets the empathetic gaze of Fannessa Fjyorne among the fallen.
events.quote: She gave him an empathetic smile of solidarity.

events.summary: Killian succumbs to Razineth's curse and suffers despair and hallucinations.
events.quote: like the six who fell before, succumbed to a cruel defeat

events.summary: Dean Shaile tells Killian in the infirmary that he must embrace the light.
events.quote: You must learn to embrace the light every now and again.

events.summary: Shaile warns him not to spend all his magic in one place.
events.quote: Don't spend all your magic in one place.

events.summary: Killian leaps onto a boat to meet his father using a water-solidifying spell.
events.quote: Killian spoke the spell aloud as he soared through the air

events.summary: Fannessa teases Killian on the boat and talks of light magic.
events.quote: So that's how the great Killian Lu is never late for anything

events.summary: Fannessa suggests a Bow's End elixir for his sore throat.
events.quote: I might know a girl who knows a guy at Bow's End that can whip one up no problem.

events.summary: Fannessa urges Killian to step out of the shadows and leaves on a boat to Bow's End.
events.quote: You should step out in the sun once in a while, Killian Lu

events.summary: Quint gives Killian a book about the Mute Quillancer who used sign language.
events.quote: Dobarius Egolt, the Mute Quillancer

events.summary: Embrose scolds Killian for relying on his inkling and being vulnerable.
events.quote: Reliance on your inkling makes you dependent, weak, and unfocused

events.summary: Embrose rejects light magic and tells Killian Oriq hearts must be broken.
events.quote: Oriq hearts do not bend in battle; mage hunter souls are never mended.

events.summary: Embrose tells Killian that his harsh teaching is for his own good.
events.quote: This is for your own good, son.

events.summary: Doco emerges from Quint's book as Killian's voice weakens.
events.quote: a mass of black ink dribbled out of it, then formed itself into an inky bobble-headed creature

events.summary: Killian meets Dina outside Bow's End, who is on a date with Vickus.
events.quote: It was his friend Dina, also a second-year.

events.summary: Killian finds Fannessa seated alone like a queen at Bow's End.
events.quote: She was seated by herself at the end of one long table like a great queen at a feast.

events.summary: Killian signs for light and the candles intensify.
events.quote: It worked.

events.summary: Vickus, jealous of Killian and Dina, absorbs a pest's life force and challenges him.
events.quote: The pest gave a screech as its life force left and entered his host.

events.summary: Killian drinks Fannessa's elixir, which heals his throat and floods him with power.
events.quote: The warmth of the honey-flavored liquid coating his throat brought with it intoxicating, renewed energy.

events.summary: Killian grows spider legs of ink and webs Vickus, shooting an ink arrow into his chest.
events.quote: The black ink arrow shot across the tavern and tore into Vickus's chest.

events.summary: Killian's ink enters Vickus, turning his eyes black.
events.quote: Killian watched as his opponent's eyes faded from gold to black.

events.summary: Killian's voice vanishes so he cannot call the curses back.
events.quote: Killian opened his mouth to call the curses back, but to his dismay, no sound escaped.

events.summary: Killian signs mercy and heals Vickus with white light.
events.quote: Vickus's eyes began to shine like two glowing suns, and his body rippled with healing gold light.

events.summary: Fannessa admits she has been following Killian for a long time.
events.quote: We've been watching you for a very, very long time.

events.summary: Fannessa reveals herself as an Oriq agent in armor and offers a mask.
events.quote: Fannessa too became engulfed in purple flames that burned her Silverquill robes away, revealing jagged, gray Oriq armor underneath.

events.summary: Fannessa orders Killian to put on the Oriq mask and join them.
events.quote: Put the mask on, Killian Lu.

events.summary: Killian declines the Oriq's offer and the mask evaporates.
events.quote: He slowly shook his head, declining the Oriq's offer.

events.summary: Fannessa reveals that mage hunters attack outside.
events.quote: Our mage hunters will wipe them all out

events.summary: Killian encases Fannessa in light and shoots a golden arrow of mercy into her.
events.quote: An arrow, golden and shimmering, imbued with virtuous intention, was conjured.

events.summary: A mage hunter bursts in and carries Fannessa away.
events.quote: several chittering legs collected her

events.summary: Killian's signed light blinds and immobilizes the mage hunters.
events.quote: Killian's spells flowed like water down their backs and along their tails, where it consumed their termini, immobilizing them.

events.summary: Students led by Dina blast the mage hunters to pieces.
events.quote: The final attack came from Dina, who hurled an enormous ball of pulsing beryl magic at the horrid creatures and shattered them into pieces.

events.summary: Vickus says Killian's light has created a way to turn the Oriq toward the light.
events.quote: You've created a way to bring them to the light.

events.summary: Embrose, Shaile and Razineth watch with the crowd as Killian wins the day.
events.quote: Embrose, arms folded and face stern, was standing amid the crowd

events.summary: Embrose shows a faint sign of approval, and patriscrit on Killian's palm declares he can create.
events.quote: it was what one might consider the beginnings of a smile, a sign of mild approval

relations.quote: the son of the great Dean Embrose Lu

relations.note: Razineth proctors the course Killian takes.
relations.quote: the renowned proctor of the Intention & Subtext II course
Killian thought of his own inkling, Doco, for a moment

relations.note: Revealed to be an Oriq agent.
relations.quote: revealing jagged, gray Oriq armor underneath

relations.note: She tries to recruit him and attacks when he refuses.
relations.quote: You're not worthy of the Oriq.

relations.note: Friends who survived Detention Bog together.
relations.quote: It was his friend Dina, also a second-year.

relations.note: After the duel they share camaraderie.
They have a contentious relationship over how to teach.
